The PA-46-701TP is a derivative product from the PA-46-600TP.
As such, the PA-46-701TP certification basis was derived from the PA-46-600TP, which includes regulations applicable to the basic PA-46-500TP.
Those regulations that are affected by the change (from the PA-46-500TP) are 14 CFR Part 23, effective February 1, 1965, as amended by 14 CFR Part 23 Amendment 23-62, effective January 31, 2012.
